title: 'I Wish I Had a Nickel' and the fish fry players
summary: Allen asks about the Barrel House number 'Wish I Had a Nickel'; Nash says players sang it at fish fries years ago and asks about the guitarist Barrel House.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I just wondered, let's see you mentioned some good Barrel House numbers. What about I Wish I Had A Nickel? Do you know that?
Wish I Had A Nickel? Go to buy some wine?
Yeah, Barrel House number. Wish I Had A Nickel? Wish I Had A Nickel?

Them guys go around and fish fry years ago and play that. Wish I Had A Nickel? They say, no I got a nickel and you got a dime. Let's get together and buy some wine. There was a guy called Barrel House. Do you remember him? He played the guitar? Yeah, I know Barrel House. What happened to him? He died, didn't he?
